title: ROBUST AI EVALUATION THROUGH MAXIMAL LOTTERIES

bias_targets.methodology: Partitioning pairwise preference votes in LMArena and Search Arena datasets by the language of the prompt (e.g., English, Polish, Russian, Chinese) to calculate group-specific win rates, worst-case performance, and preference reversals across linguistic groups.

Partitioning pairwise preference votes in the HUMAINE dataset by annotator's self-reported ethnic group (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Mixed) to measure preference disparities and worst-case model win rates for minority subpopulations.

Partitioning pairwise preference votes in the HUMAINE dataset by annotator's political affiliation (e.g., Democrat, Labour, Republican, Independent) to evaluate preference heterogeneity and group-specific model performance gaps.
